environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind the same ALB configuration, but the task runs with a custom seccomp profile (applied via ECS task definition seccompProfile field with 'localhost' type referencing /etc/ecs/seccomp/restricted.json). The seccomp profile is based on the default Docker profile but additionally denies the 'flock' syscall. The Fargate task uses an EFS mount for /var/lib/app/ with an EFS access point configured with POSIX permissions uid=1000, gid=1000, permissions=0755 on the root directory. The EFS file system has a resource policy that enforces aws:SecureTransport and denies elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite unless the IAM condition 'elasticfilesystem:AccessPointArn' matches the specific access point ARN. The access point enforces path /app-data with owner uid 1000. The task IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DataProtectionBoundary) that includes a Deny on 'elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite' with a StringNotEquals condition on 'elasticfilesystem:AccessedViaMountTarget' for the specific mount target in the private subnet. Additionally, the ALB has an AWS WAF WebACL attached with rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' in COUNT mode and a custom rule that inspects query string parameters using a regex pattern matching on the 'value' parameter: if the decoded query string value for 'value' contains patterns matching SQL comment sequences (--), semicolons followed by SQL keywords, or unbalanced single quotes exceeding 3 occurrences, the request is blocked with a 403 response. The custom WAF rule has priority 1 (evaluated first).

config.container: Custom seccomp profile denying flock syscall, read-only root filesystem except /tmp and /var/lib/app
config.storage: EFS with access point, resource policy enforcing SecureTransport and conditional write access
config.iam: Task role with permissions boundary DataProtectionBoundary, denies EFS write except via specific mount target

rules.name: custom-query-string-inspection
rules.statement: RegexPatternSet match on query string 'value' parameter: patterns ['-{2,}', ';\s*(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|UNION|ALTER)', "'{3,}"]

config.network: Private subnet, NAT gateway for egress, SG allows only ALB inbound on 8080
